info.title: Software Factory API
info.summary: Versioned HTTP surface for runs, work items, factories, scoring, benchmarks, self-improvement, secrets, integrations and webhooks.
info.description:
Every public resource route lives under `/api/v1`. Breaking changes bump the prefix and the old version keeps serving until it is removed deliberately. `GET /health` stays unversioned for probes.

**Servers.** The canonical document declares the direct API origin, `http://localhost:8080` — use it from Swagger UI, Postman or a script. The console serves the same document at `/api/openapi.json`, and `/api/openapi.json?servers=console` rewrites `servers` to the console origin (`/`): the browser then calls `/api/v1/…` same-origin and the console proxies those requests server-side, so the API host never appears in the browser and CORS never applies.

**Authentication.** The API has no authentication yet: it runs as a single implicit local user, so no security scheme is declared and try-it-out needs no credentials — anything you can read here you can also change.

This document is the source of truth: `apps/api/test/openapi.test.ts` fails when the served routes and this spec diverge.

post.description: Re-opens an escalated, failed, blocked or cancelled item at its current stage, clears the cancellation flags (the prior cancellation stays in the event log as history), records `work_item.retried` with the previous status, actor, reason and attempt, and dispatches the current stage again under a new attempt workflow id (`factory-<id>-a<n>`). `active` and `done` items are refused with `work_item_not_retryable`. A double submit within 60 seconds returns the dispatch the first call started (`deduped: true`).

201.description: Retry started: the item is active and the stage is dispatched under a new attempt.

200.description: Existing dispatch returned (deduped within the 60-second window).

503.description: orchestrator_unavailable — the attempt workflow could not be started; the item keeps its previous status.
